source_name: 12_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__012_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_036_text_description.md
text_description: A runway look centered on a close-fitting, long-sleeved black sheer crochet or lace dress, shown from head to upper thigh, with a dense allover appliqué of raised floral motifs in red, cream, and beige. The dress has a round neckline and a narrow vertical front opening at the upper chest that appears edged or tied with black cords, while the long sleeves and bodice are semi-transparent, revealing skin through the open net structure. The floral decoration is placed irregularly across the shoulders, chest, sleeves, waist, and skirt, mixing small blossoms with larger red and cream flowers; several vertical strands of small pale bead-like and red bead-like elements hang from the front, adding movement and texture. The silhouette is slim and elongated, with the ornate surface treatment creating a textured, handcrafted effect over the black mesh base. Styling includes layered gold-tone necklaces at the collarbone, long dangling gold-tone earrings, and a bright turquoise head covering or headband framing the hair near the temples. A dark object with red floral decoration is partially visible at one side near the hand, but the main focus remains the embellished sheer floral dress.
